name: Cerebras-GPT 13B
developer: Cerebras Systems (Nolan Dey, Gurpreet Gosal, Zhiming (Charles) Chen, Hemant Khachane, William Marshall, Ribhu Pathria, Marvin Tom, Joel Hestness; trained on the Cerebras Wafer-Scale Cluster)

release_date.note: Cerebras blog post dated Mar 28 2023; paper arXiv 2304.03208 v1 is dated 6 Apr 2023.

license.note: Blog: 'All models, weights, and checkpoints are available on Hugging Face and GitHub under the Apache 2.0 license.' HF repo unreachable (HTTP 401) so the card was not read.

architecture.note: HF config not retrieved (repo unreachable: HTTP 401). Values from paper Table 1 (13B row: d_model 5120, n_layers 40, d_head 128, d_ffn 20480) and section 2.1. n_heads is derived (5120 / 128 = 40); the paper gives d_head, not the head count. Positional encoding is not stated in the sections read.

n_heads.note: Derived: d_model 5120 / d_head 128; paper Table 1 does not list the count directly.

vocab_size.note: Paper sec. 2.2: GPT-2 BPE vocabulary of size 50257.

context_length.note: Paper sec. 2.1: 'maximum sequence length of 2048 tokens'.

training_data.value: The Pile (Gao et al., 2020), no deduplication; 257.1B tokens (about 20 tokens per parameter, Chinchilla-optimal).
training_data.note: Paper: 'We train Cerebras-GPT models on the Eleuther Pile dataset following DeepMind Chinchilla scaling rules'; 'We do not perform deduplication of Pile'; Table 1 total tokens 257.1B for 13B.
